paragraphs: Rabbi Bisa, another reading Bisna, Chama’s father and Oshaya Rabbah’s grandfather; see there. Of Rabbi’s court with Yishmael son of Yose. One question was put to all three; Rabbi Bisa agreed with his grandson, and “the threefold cord” was applied, Chezkat Habattim 59a.
